annotations.title: List the countries of the data

description: List the countries this server has business data for: for each its ISO code, its names in French, Arabic and English, the languages and the currency, its status (live: the data is served, planned: announced and not served yet) and the datasets it has. Algeria (DZ) is live with twelve datasets, the nine of its first release and its tax rates, social contributions and institutions, and Tunisia (TN) and Morocco (MA) with five each (governorates or regions, company legal forms, tax rates, social contributions, institutions); Morocco (MA) also has the index of its official gazette, the Bulletin officiel (list_jo_years, list_jo_issues, get_jo_issue), and Tunisia (TN) the index of its own, the Journal Officiel de la République Tunisienne (JORT), through the same three tools. Tunisia (TN) also has the activity nomenclature NAT 2009 (search_activity_codes, get_activity_code), the sections and chapters of its customs tariff (customs_tariff_sections, customs_tariff_chapters) and the CNSS contribution of the self-employed (calculate_casnos), the regime of the auto-entrepreneur as the finance law 2023 states it (search_anae_activities, get_anae_activity with the key regime; the official list of activities is not loaded) and the single contribution of the auto-entrepreneur (calculate_ifu with regime ae). Morocco (MA) also has the NMA 2010 activity nomenclature (activities), the auto-entrepreneur regime with its excluded professions (anae) and the auto-entrepreneur tax calculator (ifu). Use it first to see which countries and datasets exist before asking another tool for a country, or after a call came back country_not_available. Every country carries free_access: true when it answers without an API key (today Algeria only), false when it needs one. It takes no country, only the optional lang.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).
